missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Anomalies
missions.query: For each supplier, identify products with lead times exceeding the 75th percentile of lead times for that supplier.

missions.name: Inventory Reorder Point Breaches
missions.query: List all products with reorder points that are less than or equal to the current stock count.

missions.name: Dead Stock Detection
missions.query: Identify products that have not been sold for more than 6 months and have a stock count of 0.

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies
missions.query: For each category, calculate the average unit cost and identify categories with a standard deviation in unit cost greater than 20% of the average.

missions.name: Supplier Delayed Shipments
missions.query: Identify products with supplier delays exceeding 30 days for the last quarter.

missions.name: Product Margin Analysis
missions.query: For each product, calculate the margin as (retail_price - unit_cost) / retail_price and identify products with a margin less than 30%.

missions.name: Inventory Location Optimization
missions.query: Identify the top 5 locations with the highest average stock count and recommend relocation to improve inventory management.

missions.name: Sales Event Product Mix
missions.query: For each sales channel, calculate the top 3 products by units sold and identify channels with a product mix skewness greater than 0.5.
